findings.title: Completed-request logs lose the trace ID
findings.body: This replaces the previous explicit `traceID` log parameter with a contextual logger, but `NewContextualLoggerMiddleware` only adds endpoint and plugin/user/datasource attributes; it does not add the trace ID. As a result, `Plugin Request Completed` entries are no longer correlated with their distributed trace, making requests harder to investigate. Preserve the trace ID in the log parameters or add it to the contextual attributes.
